intended_object: The standard (Tits/Chevalley) representative of a simple reflection: for simple root αᵢ, the element nᵢ = x_{αᵢ}(1)·x_{−αᵢ}(−1)·x_{αᵢ}(1) of the Chevalley group (here the "Geck carrier" group functor), taken in the group of A-points for any commutative ring A. Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation (Carter §6.4, Steinberg §3).
explanation: The body moves the general `kostantToralWeylPoint` across the equality `geckPoints = kostantToralPointsSubgroup`. That point is defined as root-subgroup point i at ofAdd 1, times root-subgroup point j at ofAdd (−1), times root-subgroup point i at ofAdd 1. The indices used are `.inl i`, the raising generator e_i with weight +(row i of the Cartan matrix), and `.inr i`, the lowering generator f_i with weight −(row i of the Cartan matrix), as `rootGeneratorWeight_inl/inr` confirm. So the definition is exactly xᵢ(1)x₋ᵢ(−1)xᵢ(1), the textbook formula. It works for any commutative ring A, which is the natural generality for points of a Chevalley group scheme. The object belongs to this library's own construction of the Chevalley group, and Mathlib has no such construction, so a broader Mathlib notion is not available. As a specific element of a specific group, the definition is not too narrow.
